notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation. The revised one opens the 40 x 40 seat by the press clearance per side and narrows the M3 holes to Ø2.6 pilots (the tap class). It drops the taper and the lip, runs the seat up through the top face, and fills its four corners with flush pads, through which the four C-619 fan screws, sunk in countersinks, cut their thread in the fan's holes on its 32 mm square. Show the fan and screws, stand-ins drawn where the revised bracket holds them, to see the screws pass. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
